Where does spent steam go? This ledger is worth auditing line by line. Plain steam condenses at §1160L to 1L§r distilled water into the normal cooling hatch; superheated steam degrades §11:1§r back into plain steam and lands in the pressure cooling hatch.

Nothing is lost without a hatch either — leftovers pend until one is fitted (since v1.10.61).

Return that distilled water to the boiler, and scale stops being your problem.

§2Distilled water back to the boiler, no more scale headaches.§r
